preregistered_before_search.hypothesis: MJ-P01 already recorded on main before this investigation
preregistered_before_search.scope: Eve 680-sf whole compact and Maxim 825-sf 2BR, with local accommodation controls
questions: Does exclusive compact accommodation command a repeatable net premium after package matching?
What price/rent/cost differences reverse cash and return preference?
Does the future buyer support the exit burden under no growth and tighter credit?
preregistered_before_search.evidence_priority: Dated identifiable sale/rent offers and public transaction records, followed by local controls; never equate advertisements to paid leases
preregistered_before_search.stop: Complete one bounded public evidence packet and numerical rank/exit sensitivity; stop active searching if private collection, occupancy or governance evidence is unavailable rather than repeat portal searches
preregistered_before_search.constraints: No contact, paid data, booking or purchase. No Core/SOP/old input changes. Missing achieved rent is not negative demand evidence.
counterexamples: Eve premium consumed by furnishing, fees or void
Maxim cheaper price and extra room improve net economics
preregistered_before_search.forecast_policy: No assumed privacy premium or growth; all new ranges are ask-derived sensitivities with material uncertainty.

historical_cases.name: Eve Suite compact
historical_cases.source_note: Sale is fully furnished, one bay, header 1+1 versus body 1BR. Historical product record calls 680-sf stock studios. Base rent is an asking-informed whole-unit assumption, not a signed lease.
historical_cases.mechanism: A lower entry quantum may monetise Ara accessibility for small households without family-sized acquisition cost.
historical_cases.buyer: Primary resale underwriting is investor-led. Single/couple owner adoption is possible but unmeasured. Pacific Place 864-sf two-bedroom and Eve 1065-sf two-bedroom compete on different space/price tradeoffs.
historical_cases.project: Historic studio-heavy mix increases correlated small-unit competition; it does not establish current investor ownership or vacancy. No MC records inspected.
historical_cases.comp: Brickz reports 18 mixed transactions in May 2025-April 2026; a visible 689-sf/3-room RM364k row cannot be treated as an exact 680-sf studio match.
historical_cases.reversal: At assumed costs the low-rent case fails monthly coverage; even base coverage can coexist with negative annual carry. A small charge or net-rent difference can reverse the lead.
historical_cases.next: Resolve approved room/area and bay rights; obtain ordinary leases near RM2k and charges; test a matched compact transfer and current competing inventory. Reopen priority only if this changes the financial or exit burden.
historical_cases.g0: STOP: no unit-matched normalised clearing interval
